card.name: Second number's first digit after comma
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number that comes right after a comma in a list or series of numbers, so the digit is separated from its leading digits. Seen in year lists, counts and percentages.

modes.label: Year lists
modes.description: The first digit of a year after a comma in a list of dates or ranges.

modes.label: Counts and percentages
modes.description: The first digit of a count or percentage after a comma in a series of figures.

card.plain: It fires on the opening digit of a number that follows a comma in a list of figures or years.
